identity.note: UFC athlete page: Raul Rosas Jr., bantamweight, age 22, 13-1-0, hometown Clovis NM, trains at Rosas Brothers MMA. Sherdog (born Oct 8 2004, Santa Rosa CA, 10th Planet Las Vegas) and Conan Daily (born in Clovis NM) agree: born in Clovis, raised in Santa Rosa, so the hometown difference is not a confl

claims.text: Wikipedia says he took up wrestling in high school, without naming the school or giving any results or titles.

sources_checked.name: FloWrestling (web search for Raul Rosas Jr)

wrestling.note: Only Wikipedia mentions high school wrestling, with no school or results. A FloWrestling-targeted web search found no profile for him; UFC, Sherdog and Jits Magazine pages do not mention wrestling.

claims.text: His UFC profile says he has won NAGA grappling belts, giving no event, year or division.
claims.level_note: NAGA tournament division wins, details not given

claims.text: At 16 he won the 155 lb professional division of the Submission Only Series in Orange County, beating two black belts on the way.

grappling.note: Several professional submission-grappling results are reported by outlets, each from a single Tier B source. No NAGA, ADCC or federation results page could be opened (NAGA results page and Smoothcomp returned 403), so the NAGA belts stay unverified.

judo.note: No source mentions judo; IJF and JudoInside were not searched.

kickboxing.note: No source mentions kickboxing; WAKO and kickboxing databases were not searched.

boxing.note: Conan Daily says his father is a boxing coach, which is not a credential for him. BoxRec was not searched.

claims.text: When he signed with the UFC in 2022 he was reported to be a purple belt training at Eddie Bravo's 10th Planet Jiu Jitsu in Las Vegas.
A 2025 profile describes him as a first-degree BJJ black belt, with no promotion date or promoting instructor.
Wikipedia's infobox lists him as a first-degree BJJ black belt with 10th Planet Jiu Jitsu, without a citation.

bjj.note: Rank is not confirmed by any federation or lineage record (BJJ Heroes returned 403). A 2022 Tier B outlet said purple belt; later outlets say black belt with no promotion date or promoter. Wikipedia's 1st-degree black belt entry has no citation.

sambo.note: No source mentions sambo; FIAS was not searched.
